queries.summary: The Q4 product roadmap outlines key features and initiatives planned for the final quarter of 2025, including major product launches, infrastructure improvements, and customer-facing enhancements.

queries.summary: The company handbook outlines the PTO (Paid Time Off) policy, including accrual rates, usage guidelines, and approval processes.
key_points: PTO accrues at 1.25 days per month for full-time employees
PTO requests require manager approval with 2 weeks notice
Unused PTO can be carried over up to 5 days to the next year
PTO includes vacation, sick leave, and personal days

queries.search_instructions: When users ask for documents about a topic, search the knowledge base using the topic keywords. Available sources include: Company Drive, Confluence, Notion, Google Drive, and internal wikis.
